body:
After four years of growth and countless events,  the community of the commons hub is truly one of a kind. Rooted in the Crypto Commons movement—established and nurtured by the Hub’s co-founder Felix—this network has expanded far beyond its origins. Going beyond crypto, today it integrates influences from permaculture, the arts, mindfulness, conceptual and strategy games, automation, and meta-modernism.

What unites these diverse threads is a shared determination to challenge the status quo: to embark on bold inquiries, embrace unconventional perspectives, ask uncomfortable questions, and maintain independence from funders and other power holders. Against the odds, this community dares to explore and create, not only resisting the mainstream but actively imagining and building alternatives.

These shared experiences of thinking outside the box, confronting adversity, and striving for change have forged deep bonds of solidarity and friendship. Over time, these connections have given rise to a shared worldview: an understanding that the challenges ahead demand collective strength, resilience, and humanity.

Its community makes the commons hub more than a place; it’s a beacon of determination and responsibility. Together, we are committed to building pockets of resistance and resilience—spaces where a new system and society can take root and flourish. This vision of standing together through transformation continues to guide and inspire everything the Hub represents.
summary: Közösségünket sokszínűsége, közösségi érzése és szolidaritása határozza meg. Itt kialakult kapcsolatok gyakran túlmutatnak a munkán, mély és tartós barátságokká alakulva.

sections.heading: History

items.title: The House
items.text: Built in 1860 as a countryside inn, the house was transformed into an artist colony in 2013. It has hosted retreats and gatherings since 2020, and was formalized as the Commons Hub in 2023.

items.title: The Village
items.text: Reichenau an der Rax was a 19th-century summer residence of the nobility — leaving behind dozens of villas, castles and pavilions. Hirschwang, the tiny village the Commons Hub sits in, always stayed industrial: wood, iron ore, a battery factory and a paper mill. Both villages have been in slow decay ever since — the ground we're now helping to bring back to life.

body:
Based in the Hirschwangerhof, a historic countryside inn one hour south of Vienna, the Commons Hub is nested in the Austrian Alps near Reichenau an der Rax, once the Habsburg Monarchy's summer retreat.

The Hirschwangerhof accommodates 30 overnight guests and up to 100 event guests, while the extraordinary natural and cultural surroundings offer diverse outside activities and adventures.

Conceptually, the Hub aims to be an open community space and experimental playground for radical thinkers and doers, bridging the progressive web3 ecosystem and the broader Commons movement.

body:
not your standard event location


From intimate team retreats, project weeks and nonprofit offsites to multi-day conferences, hackathons, and community gatherings — the commons hub makes for unforgettable experiences.


Our Vibe

Laid-back, but intentional.
Minimal formalities. Maximum freedom.
The kind of place that feels familiar, even at first sight.


OUR PHILOSOPHY

We believe in “events as commons” —
shaped by mutual care, respect, and serendipity.
The magic begins where structure gives way for emergence and surprise.


Common areas

Several common areas embed and connect our dedicated event spaces:

Lounge

The heart of the house — vintage couches, a weathered bar, and a vinyl record player for late-night moods.

Shared Kitchen
Once the heart of a restaurant, our kitchen is stocked with enough pots and pans to feed a small revolution.

Garden

Big enough for frisbee, cozy enough for quiet moments. Includes a fire bowl, herb beds, and a FarmBot with a life of its own.


Event Space packages

All prices include 20% VAT. Bookings are binding after a 30% down payment.

Small  (up to 15 people)
€200/day for our Seminar Room

45 m2 Seminar Room


Medium (up to 35 people)
€500/day for Seminar Room + 2 Event Halls à 90m²
90 m2 Conference Hall

Large (up to 65 people)
€700/day for Seminar Room + 2 Event Halls à 90m²

Main Stage with piano, A/V and live streaming setup


Extra Large (up to 100 people)
€1000/day for Seminar Room + 2 Event Halls à 90m²

90 m2 Workshop Hall, here used for an exhibition


HOW TO BOOK

We’re working on our own booking app — but for now, email works best.
Send a message to office@commons-hub.at
with the subject "Booking: Event Space" and include:

  • A short event description

  • Number of participants

  • Desired space package (Small / Medium / etc.)

  • First and last event day

  • Catering: €35/person/day or self-catering?

  • Any open questions

  • Three time slots for a first call

Our team will get back to you shortly with the next steps.

Welcome to the commons hub,


a communal guesthouse and events venue in the Austrian Alps, just one hour south of Vienna.


The commons hub is a harbor for artists, dreamers, hackers, and tinkerers — a shared space where people and ideas meet to weave new perspectives across technology, economy, society, and nature in pursuit of sustainable futures.

Its intimate atmosphere, egalitarian principles and stunning natural surroundings foster deep and lasting connections among peers. Be it a conference, a retreat, or a celebration among friends — Here, ideas flourish, connections deepen, and memories are made.

body:
From solo wanderers and digital nomads
to small teams, artists-in-residence, and friends passing through —
the commons hub offers more than just a place to sleep.


It’s a space to slow down, plug in (or out), and feel at home.
Not your average guesthouse.


Multiple communities have shaped this house over the years.
You feel it in the details — from scrappy fixes to shared jokes that stuck around.


Laid-back, but intentional.
Minimal rules. Maximum freedom.
A place to feel at home — even if you just arrived.




Common areas

Before picking a bed or room, here's what's yours no matter what:


Lounge
The heart of the house — vintage couches, a weathered bar, and a record player and vinyls for late-night moods.

Shared Kitchen
Once a restaurant kitchen — now the stage for late-night cooking sessions.
Fully stocked with utensils, spices, oils, and enough pots and pans to feed a small revolution.


Garden

Big enough for frisbee, cozy enough for quiet moments.
Includes a fire bowl, herb beds, shady corners — and a FarmBot with a life of its own.




rooms & prices

All prices include 10% VAT + city taxes (local tourist tax 3€ and climate contribution 1€).

Dormitory (4–6 people/room): €35.20 + €4 per person/night


Twin Room (2 separate beds): €46.20 + €4 per person/night


Double Room (shared bed): €46.20 + €4 per person/night


Single Occupancy: €85 + €4 per night

☞ Special rates may be available for longer stays — just ask.




How to book

We are working on our own booking app — but for now, just send us an email to office@commons-hub.at with the subject "Booking: Accommodation" and include:

  • Number of guests

  • Room preference (single, double, twin, dormitory)

  • Arrival and departure dates

Our team will respond shortly with the next steps.
